title:
Cuckooing is when criminals take over someone else’s home and use it as a base for illegal activity — most commonly drug dealing.

Criminals (often linked to county lines drug gangs) target people who are vulnerable, such as:
 • People with drug or alcohol dependency
 • Those with mental health difficulties
 • Elderly or socially isolated individuals
 • People in poverty or unstable housing

Well done to our tenants and staff who attended training and are now Cuckooing aware!

#bluepitshousingaction #training
#cuckooing
